mission_title: Warehouse inventory reservation and idempotent allocation
scenario: An imaginary retailer needs stock reservation with expiry, a read-only availability API and consistency under retries. Compare architecture options using only these fictional source documents, with no claims of deployed proof.

sources.text: Mission INVENTORY-02 covers inventory reservation and expiry. Canonical repo lab/inventory-api owns stock availability API and reservation request validation. The design lacks an explicit timeout acceptance test. This is a synthetic design; no system is deployed.

Mission INVENTORY-02 requires retry-safe stock allocation. Canonical repo lab/stock-ledger owns reservation IDs, stock mutation journal and idempotency keys. Duplicate delivery is possible in the design. Compensating release is a proposal and has no measured recovery proof.
